reviews.summary: NIL appears to be Nillion. A live L2→Ethereum L1 node migration began September 26, with an October 5 mainnet transition and a ~9-day bridge path; a large scheduled unlock cycle also remains active.
materialRisks: Operational-transition risk: Nillion began migrating Blacklight node operations from its L2 to Ethereum L1 on September 26; the legacy L2 is slated for retirement later in 2026, and bridge withdrawals are expected to take about nine days.

Supply-overhang risk: the September 24 unlock was recent, and the next scheduled release is October 24: 24.55M NIL (2.5% of total supply; reported as ~5.5% of market cap), including foundation, investor, and insider allocations.

facts.fact: Nillion’s official September 26 announcement says Blacklight L1 mainnet is planned for October 5, 2026; existing L2 participants must unstake, withdraw, bridge NIL/ETH to Ethereum, and register again on L1.
The official migration guidance states L2-to-L1 bridging is expected to take around nine days and that Blacklight L2 will halt later in 2026.
A current token-unlock tracker lists the next NIL release on October 24, 2026 as 24,549,372 NIL (2.5% of total supply; ~5.5% of market cap).
The same tracker lists a September 24, 2026 NIL unlock and reports continued vesting through February 2029.
